# Workshop logistics

This section is reserved for venue details, travel instructions, local transportation, contact information, and online participation guidance.

## Location

Santa Cruz Island, Galápagos

## Dates

June 8 to June 12, 2026

## Venue

The workshop will be hosted on **Santa Cruz Island, Galápagos**.

The current venue is **Charles Darwin Foundation**, Santa Cruz, Galápagos. Additional access details and meeting instructions will be shared closer to the workshop date.

## Accommodation

Participants will be accommodated at the following hotels in Puerto Ayora:

- **CASA GALÁPAGOS by Hostal Fragata**  
  Calle Escalecia y Petrel #069  
  200102 Puerto Ayora, Ecuador

- **Isla Azul**  
  Fragata y Floreana  
  200350 Puerto Ayora, Ecuador

## Venue and Accommodation Map

The map below shows the workshop venue and accommodation locations in Puerto Ayora. Blue marks the venue, and orange marks accommodation.

<link
  rel="stylesheet"
  href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css"
  crossorigin=""
>

<script
  src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"
  crossorigin=""></script>

<div class="map-embed">
  <div id="venue-accommodation-map" class="leaflet-map" aria-label="Venue and accommodation map"></div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const mapElement = document.getElementById("venue-accommodation-map");
  if (!mapElement || typeof L === "undefined") return;

  const locations = [
    {
      name: "Charles Darwin Foundation",
      type: "Venue",
      address: "Charles Darwin Research Station, Puerto Ayora, Santa Cruz, Galápagos",
      lat: -0.7441,
      lng: -90.3023,
      markerClass: "venue-marker"
    },
    {
      name: "CASA GALÁPAGOS by Hostal Fragata",
      type: "Accommodation",
      address: "Calle Escalecia y Petrel #069, 200102 Puerto Ayora, Ecuador",
      lat: -0.7399,
      lng: -90.3147,
      markerClass: "accommodation-marker"
    },
    {
      name: "Isla Azul",
      type: "Accommodation",
      address: "Fragata y Floreana, 200350 Puerto Ayora, Ecuador",
      lat: -0.7446,
      lng: -90.3144,
      markerClass: "accommodation-marker"
    }
  ];

  const map = L.map(mapElement, { scrollWheelZoom: false });
  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
    maxZoom: 19,
    attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors'
  }).addTo(map);

  const bounds = [];
  locations.forEach((location) => {
    const marker = L.marker([location.lat, location.lng], {
      icon: L.divIcon({
        className: `custom-map-marker ${location.markerClass}`,
        html: '<span></span>',
        iconSize: [22, 22],
        iconAnchor: [11, 11]
      })
    }).addTo(map);

    const mapsUrl = `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(location.address)}`;
    marker.bindPopup(`
      <strong>${location.name}</strong><br>
      ${location.type}<br>
      ${location.address}<br>
      <a href="${mapsUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open in Google Maps</a>
    `);
    bounds.push([location.lat, location.lng]);
  });

  map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [28, 28] });
});
</script>

## Travel note

Participants may need to stay overnight on mainland Ecuador on **June 7, 2026** before flying to **Galápagos** on **June 8, 2026**, depending on their travel itinerary.

Additional travel instructions, hotel details, and local transportation information will be shared by email.
